what: The declared boundary-walk instrument: the state space 1296 ordered types with the boundary mark's row and column excluded on both sides and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries, with the real's own kept-adjacent pair sequence walked by one declared boundary head across declared step positions between the stream's first and second declared boundaries, the two window-mass spans beside the head priced fresh at every position, the direction tables recorded at every position, no bands and no envelopes. The declared truthful questions: where the second span's top_1 spike begins and ends along the stream, and whether the opening span's above-whole concentration turns off at a declared location or drifts smoothly across positions, the flip locations the stream-position instrument left to within a quarter of the stream. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument and the stream-position instrument declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, and the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side)
declared.walk_rule: the window mass fixed at the standing basis arithmetic's first boundary - the int(quarter x the anchor basis) positions with the anchor basis the kept pair total + 1, so the window mass is ZL 54,604, GC 45,800 and IT 55,133 kept-adjacent pairs - and the head walked at int(step x the anchor basis) positions for the declared steps j / 100 with j running 25 to 50 inclusive, 26 heads per file, the first head exactly the standing first boundary and the last head exactly the standing second boundary; at every head the two spans beside the head are the window-mass span ending at the head and the window-mass span starting at the head, each priced fresh, no pair dropped, no pair synthesized, and the first head's two spans are exactly the stream-position instrument's first and second segments while the last head's two spans are exactly its second and third
declared.summary_rule: each profile is priced fresh through the same mark-excluded block and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries the standing instruments declare; no profile is compared to any simulated profile anywhere in this artifact
declared.no_band_rule: no rung band is loaded, no envelope is formed, no verdict and no scalar margin is produced anywhere in this artifact: the declared question is answered by direction, and the frozen rung bands stay the frozen instruments' declared records, untouched here
declared.direction_rule: each span records, for each of the six scalar summaries it shares with the whole profile (the empty type count, the self-pair share, the top-k shares at k 1, 10 and 50, and the pair entropy), whether its value sits above, below or equal to the whole sequence's value at the stored 6-decimal rounding, every entry recorded and no selection performed over anything
declared.roster_rule: the corpus-breadth roster stands unchanged: the same eight accepted corpus files, the same rejected candidates with their verbatim causes, the same sha256 records, the roster floor and the fetch verification are the corpus-breadth artifact's declared facts taken by reference, no corpus file is re-fetched, re-probed or re-hashed here, and no encoding is re-run anywhere: this instrument prices the real's own side only
declared.state_note: the real's kept-adjacency is real adjacency with 126 unmapped events inside ZL's 218,663, 1,769 inside GC's 186,708, none inside IT's 220,532, exactly as disclosed since the interior instrument; the real's side is identical for both languages of a file, so every cell prices the same walk records; the whole-sequence profile is anchored to the frozen real-at-basis ladder's anchor profile in the gate
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags, and no seed of any kind: the heads are the declared arithmetic and every profile is priced fresh from the real's own pair sequence, so the standing budgets and the seed-kind registry play no part here
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its declared window after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.record_rule: per cell the artifact records the kept pair total, the window mass, the whole-sequence profile with its boundary-carried pairs, the frozen stream-position boundaries taken by reference, and the 26 head records in order, each carrying its declared step, its head position, and its two spans, each span carrying its first and end positions, its window mass, its own boundary-carried pairs, its fresh profile (the block total, both vector summaries as counts and shares, the empty type count, the self-pair share, the top-k shares and the pair entropy) and its direction record against the whole profile's six scalar summaries, every entry recorded
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is the direction run at every declared head per span, and the record answers it entry by entry
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.gate_rule: before any span at any declared head is recorded beyond the gate, the gate verified fresh per cell: the whole profile against the frozen real-at-basis ladder's anchor profile, the fresh stream-position boundaries and sizes against the frozen stored ones, the 26 heads against the declared rule, the two window sizes at every head, the first head's two spans against the frozen stream-position first and second segment profiles and the last head's against its second and third, and the whole's own identity, 86 fields per cell, 516 fields all told; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.confluence_rule: the walk's endpoints are the stream-position instrument's frozen records taken by reference and verified field for field in the gate: the first head's left span is that instrument's first segment and its right span the second, the last head's left span the second segment and its right span the third, so the walk begins and ends inside the stream-position instrument's declared partition and its heads are declared arithmetic in between
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
